source_rules.rationale: Adds the mathematical fact that negative-one indexing of a nonempty sequence ending in snocVS returns its appended value; Stage 1 uses this rule while proving the program claims but never first proves the exact rule in a definition that omits it.

rule <k>
         Subscript(
           list(vCons(_F:Int, snocVS(_M:ValSeq, L:Int))),
           UnaryOp("-", Int(1)))
         => L
         ...
       </k>
       [priority(40)]
